name: Fast Gaussian Rasterization (Covariance Eigen-decomposition and Quad Emission)
definition: A rasterization method for 3D Gaussians that projects the 3D covariance to 2D, computes eigenvalues/vectors to determine basis vectors, and emits a quad per splat to the fragment shader for alpha-based blending.
summary: Fast Gaussian Rasterization projects 3D Gaussians to 2D, computes eigenvalues and eigenvectors to determine basis vectors, and emits a quad per splat for alpha-based blending.
